name: Jati Tinggi Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Jati Tinggi Group Berhad 通过认购 Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd 51% 股权，将业务扩展至管道相关领域；同时，其全资子公司 Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd 在 Public Bank Berhad 的 PV Solar Panel System 项目中持续获得额外授标，截至最新公告累计合约金额达 RM7.81 million。
overview_en: In 2026, Jati Tinggi Group Berhad expanded into the pipe-related business by subscribing for a 51% equity interest in Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd. Meanwhile, its wholly-owned subsidiary Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd continued to receive additional letters of award under Public Bank Berhad's PV Solar Panel System project, with the aggregate contract sum reaching RM7.81 million as at the latest announcement.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面完成对 Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd 的 51% 股权认购，并通过 Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd 持续获得 Public Bank Berhad 的 PV Solar Panel System 项…
segments.note_en: At the group level, the Company completed the subscription for a 51% equity interest in Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd and continued to receive letters of award from Public Bank Berhad for the PV Solar Panel Sys…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Public Bank Berhad 向 Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd 额外发出 1 份授标函，供应及安装 PV Solar Panel System，合约金额 RM0.78 million；截至公告日累计合约金额为 RM7.81 million。
actions.text_en: Public Bank Berhad issued an additional 1 letter of award to Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd for the supply and installation of PV Solar Panel System with a contract sum of RM0.78 million; the aggregate contract sum as at the announcement date was RM7.81 million.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Public Bank Berhad 向 Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd 额外发出 1 份授标函，供应及安装 PV Solar Panel System，合约金额 RM0.60 million；截至公告日累计合约金额为 RM7.03 million。
actions.text_en: Public Bank Berhad issued an additional 1 letter of award to Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd for the supply and installation of PV Solar Panel System with a contract sum of RM0.60 million; the aggregate contract sum as at the announcement date was RM7.03 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 股份认购于2026年4月10日完成，Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd 成为公司持股 51% 的子公司。
actions.text_en: The share subscription was completed on 10 April 2026, and Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd became a 51%-owned subsidiary of the Company.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述股份认购协议的先决条件于2026年3月31日全部满足，协议转为无条件。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent to the share subscription agreement were fulfilled on 31 March 2026, and the agreement became unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于2026年3月5日与 Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd 签订有条件股份认购协议，以现金 RM6,119,998.08 认购 520,408 股新股，占扩大后已发行股份约 51.00%。
actions.text_en: On 5 March 2026, entered into a conditional share subscription agreement with Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd to subscribe for 520,408 new ordinary shares, representing approximately 51.00% of the enlarged issued shares, for a cash consideration of RM6,119,998.08.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Public Bank Berhad 向 Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd 额外发出 2 份授标函，供应及安装 PV Solar Panel System，合约总额 RM1.67 million；截至公告日累计合约金额为 RM6.43 million。
actions.text_en: Public Bank Berhad issued an additional 2 letters of award to Jati Tinggi Holding Sdn Bhd for the supply and installation of PV Solar Panel System with a total contract sum of RM1.67 million;

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司通过认购 Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd 51% 股权，将该公司纳入为子公司，新增管道相关业务。
model_changes.text_en: The Company brought Roflex Pipe Sdn Bhd into the group as a 51%-owned subsidiary through the share subscription, adding a pipe-related business.
